hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Orlando Resort

booking1.question: How can I book a chalet?
booking1.answer: You can easily book through our website. Choose the suitable chalet, select your stay dates, then follow the simple booking steps.

booking2.question: What payment methods are available?
booking2.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) and bank transfers.

cancel1.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancel1.answer: You can cancel for free up to 48 hours before arrival. After that, fees will apply.

cancel2.question: Can I modify my booking?
cancel2.answer: Yes, you can modify your booking up to 24 hours before arrival, subject to chalet availability.

amenities1.question: What facilities are available in the chalets?
amenities1.answer: Facilities include: private pool, fully equipped kitchen, free WiFi, central air conditioning, and private parking.

amenities2.question: Is room service available?
amenities2.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 room service with a diverse food menu.

common.contactSupport: Didn't find an answer? Contact us
